title: Binary open fibre descent retains uniform constructibility and Tor bounds
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms. Put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\ge1$. For a scheme $T$ use the ordinary derived category $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ of strict varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Write $\mathcal C_T$ for its full subcategory whose levels have bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, in common intervals independent of $n$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. No normalization is required. At level $n$ write $\mathcal C_{T,n}=D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ in the ordinary constant-ring module derived category. For each separated finite-type map $h$ choose a coefficient-independent compactification and write $F_h=Rh_{!,\bullet}$ and $F_{h,n}=Rh_{!,A_n}$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

Let $Z=U\cup V$ be a binary open cover, put $W=U\cap V$, and let $j_D:D\hookrightarrow Z$ denote the open immersions. Suppose $P\in\mathcal C_U$, $Q\in\mathcal C_V$ have common cohomological interval $[a,b]$ and common Tor interval $[u,v]$, and let $c:P|_W\xrightarrow{\sim}Q|_W$ be an isomorphism in the ordinary derived tower category. Then there are $G\in\mathcal C_Z$ and restriction isomorphisms $a_U:G|_U\xrightarrow{\sim}P$, $a_V:G|_V\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ with $a_V|_W=c\,a_U|_W$. One can choose a distinguished triangle in the ambient ordinary derived tower category
$$G\longrightarrow Rj_{U*}P\oplus Rj_{V*}Q\xrightarrow{(Rj_*c,-1)}Rj_{W*}(Q|_W)\longrightarrow G[1].$$
The middle direct images are not required to be constructible. The levels of $G$ have cohomology in $[a,b]$ and Tor amplitude in $[u,v]$, and intrinsically constructible cohomology.

Precisely, in the Grothendieck topos of inverse systems on $Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the constant inverse systems of the subterminal sheaves $U,V,W$ define open slice topoi. Their rings are the strict varying coefficient rings $A_\bullet|_D$, and their module categories identify with $\operatorname{Tow}(D,\mathcal O_E)$ through the site equivalences and constant-section ring identifications of [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. These identifications preserve all quotient maps $A_n\to A_m$. The fibre triangle is the ordinary ringed-topos binary descent construction [lem-sp-ringed-topos-binary-descent], with these slice identifications. Restriction and evaluation of $G$ have the selected local models. In particular neither constructibility of $Rj_*$ nor a shift of the displayed fibre is an additional hypothesis.

proof.text: Define the middle arrow d by the displayed difference of adjunction mates and complete it to a distinguished cocone triangle G -> R_U P direct-sum R_V Q -> R_W Q|W -> G[1], using the ordinary derived triangulated structure. Apply lem-sp-tower-fibre-projections to this triangle. Package its two invertible counit projections as aU and aV; their defining counit formulas hold by construction.

source.place: Gluing: fibre triangle and counit projections

proof.text: The triangle relation f followed by d=0 gives overlap compatibility. Transpose both restricted projections through the W-adjunction. Naturality of the composition comparisons and adjunction homEquiv makes the two transposes respectively f followed by projection_1 followed by res_U and R_W(c), and f followed by projection_2 followed by res_V. Expand biprod.desc as projection_1 followed by its first component minus projection_2 followed by res_V. The zero-composite relation equates these maps; injectivity of homEquiv yields exactly the required overlap equation.

source.place: Gluing: overlap equation from the zero composite

proof.text: The finite-type structure morphism to Spec k makes Z locally Noetherian; its quasi-compactness and compactness of Spec k make Z compact, hence Noetherian. For each n, evaluatedRestrictionIso is the specified pullEvaluation comparison followed by evaluation of aU or aV. Apply lem-sp-proetale-binary-ctf-local-models with coefficient ring A=R ell E n, global object Ev_n G, and these evaluated local models. The hypotheses are exactly hP n and hQ n. Its conclusion gives intrinsic constructibility, the same cohomological interval and the same Tor interval for every n.

Prove the evaluated local models termwise, uniform cohomological and Tor vanishing by the binary sheaf zero test, and constructibility by an explicit finite partition. tool_uses.why: Generic strict sequence-topos open localization identifies the ambient tower slices, not the geometric adjunction being constructed.
Generic exactness of slice module restriction is needed for levelwise cohomology and Tor tests.
Generic monoidal derived pullback for ringed topoi specializes to exact open restriction and the Tor test; it replaces no geometric route step.
Generic inverse image of a constant module supplies unchanged finite models on cut strata, for arbitrary finite modules, rather than only free local systems.
The existing definition records base change preserving pro-etale covers for the trivializing covers on cut strata.

The statement, stmt_deps, blueprint and source fields are byte-identical to the creating Q149 snapshot, so the target is unchanged. Live and side-live still hold the item unsplit, so the delivery is not superseded. No repair note exists for this item. The DAG has no cycle, and the split contains no SGA. Step-by-step checks. Step 1: lem-pur-sequence-site-open-extension says levelwise inverse image is the localization at the constant subterminal and identifies the rings. lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization (1), (2), (4) give the slice site and identify the constant ring by the identity on constant sections, so the quotient maps are compatible. The semilinear-system category is by definition Tow from sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers. Step 2: the hypotheses of lem-sp-ringed-topos-binary-descent (1) hold in the inverse-system topos; it gives the exact unshifted fibre triangle, a, b and the overlap equation. Step 3: restriction and evaluation are both exact and act termwise, so they commute; elementary. Step 4: zero test on the cover T×U, T×V; elementary, uniform in n. Step 5: the slice localization has an isomorphic structural ring map, so Lu^* is restriction. The tensor-pullback node and the universal module quantifier of def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude give Tor amplitude in [u,v]. Step 6: the strata S_α and T_β×_Z C are locally closed in Z (checked T_β∩C = O∩(F∩C)), constructible because Z is Noetherian, and partition Z. Covers are base-changed, and constant finite models pull back without freeness. Small gap accepted: composing pullbacks is used without a citation. Step 7 matches the definition in sk-def-sp-normalized-towers, with no normalization required. Small cases checked: U=Z, W empty, Z empty, zero complexes, a=b and u=v. Advisory: lem-sf-finite-cover-ctf-locality states levelwise ctf locality; the steps re-prove the binary case inline, which is not a duplicate node. Accepted all 5 tool_uses as generic tools that replace no route step.
